## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Comillas, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at El Capricho de Gaudí, Bo. Sobrellano, s/n, 39520 Comillas, Cantabria, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Capricho de Gaud. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ticket to Capricho de Gaudí is included on this self-guided audio walking tour of Comillas. Please note that an audio tour inside Capricho de Gaudí is not provided within this bundle but is available on site.
>
> You begin at El Capricho de Gaudí, one of Antoni Gaudí’s earliest and most imaginative houses. From there, the walk leads through the historic center, past the Chapel Mausoleum of the Marquises of Comillas and the Palace of Sobrellano, then uphill to the former Pontifical University complex and the seminary church. The route continues by the Old Town Hall, Casa del Duque, Parque Güell y Martos, the Pescadera monument, the harbor, and ends at the Mirador de Comillas.
>
> The route follows Comillas through its most striking layers, from early Modernisme to noble patronage, religious ambition, and everyday coastal life. Along the way, traveler will enjoy Gaudí’s sunflower-covered fantasy, neo-Gothic palace architecture, wide sea views, the working atmosphere of the port, and the revealing contrast between grand monuments and humble fishing traditions.
